note: With x = x_{m+1} and L_m x = x_m the three inequalities are the three displayed ones, with C_{J_m} = (params m).columns.

snippet.text:
cap : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m ≤ N → ∀ v,
    (T.entries m v).remBound 0 (H.rep N p m) (Real.sqrt (H.levels.clock.forcedAllowance m))
      ((H.levels.params m).columns * F.coeffSize (F.core (T.entries m v).x))
  back : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    F.coeffSize (T.entries (m+1) v).x ≤ (H.levels.params (m+1)).columns * F.coeffSize (T.entries m v).x
  front : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    F.coeffSize (T.entries m v).x ≤ (H.levels.params (m+1)).columns * ((H.S.block m).val : ℝ)^d *
      F.coeffSize (T.entries (m+1) v).x

proof_context.conclusion: `cap`: remainder norm (regular plus forced divided by sqrt of the forced allowance) is at most `columns m * coeffSize (core x_m)`; `back`: `coeffSize x_{m+1} <= columns (m+1) * coeffSize x_m`; `front`: `coeffSize x_m <= columns (m+1) * block^d * coeffSize x_{m+1}`.
